development_aim: Kernel/tool server for mcp-bridge and MCP clients with protocol validation, memory integration, LLM tools, and stdio MCP adapter.
executive_summary: mcp-server now has an additional MCP stdio entrypoint at src/mcp/stdio-server.js using @modelcontextprotocol/sdk and StdioServerTransport. The adapter exposes a deliberately small safe tool set: memory_ingest, memory_query, and llm_complete. core.memoryIngest was fixed to preserve an omitted id as undefined when calling mcp-memory.ingestText(text, { id, metadata }), allowing mcp-memory to generate its UUID and return { ok: true, id: string }. voice.outboundCall, voice.getCallStatus, and voice.getCallResult now support the existing mock provider plus a tightly gated Twilio provider for first own-phone testing. Twilio voice flow supports responseMode gather or record; record mode captures caller audio metadata for later STT without connecting Google/OpenAI transcription or supplier batch calls. Real Twilio calls still require approved true, VOICE_PROVIDER=twilio, VOICE_CALLS_ENABLED=true, configured Twilio env vars, PUBLIC_VOICE_BASE_URL, and a phoneNumber present in VOICE_ALLOWED_TEST_NUMBERS; supplier batch calls are not implemented. Existing WebSocket server imports still pass, tools/index.js still loads, npm test passes, and memoryIngest import validation passes. Live OpenAI calls, live Twilio calls, and live bridge retest were not run.

response_modes.gather: Default mode. Twilio Gather performs direct speech recognition and stores SpeechResult/Confidence when Twilio returns them.
response_modes.record: Preferred Lithuanian test mode right now. Twilio says the intro and first question, records caller audio, uses both Record action and recordingStatusCallback to the recording-result route, stores RecordingSid/RecordingUrl/duration/CallSid, and leaves transcriptionPending true until a later STT integration.

environment_gates.VOICE_PROVIDER: Defaults to mock; twilio is supported only behind additional gates.
environment_gates.VOICE_CALLS_ENABLED: Defaults to false; Twilio calls reject with CALLS_DISABLED unless this is exactly true.
environment_gates.VOICE_ALLOWED_TEST_NUMBERS: Comma-separated E.164 allowlist; Twilio calls reject unless phoneNumber is included.
environment_gates.TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID: Required for provider=twilio; never returned in tool output or status JSON.
environment_gates.TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN: Required for provider=twilio; never returned in tool output or status JSON.
environment_gates.PUBLIC_VOICE_BASE_URL: Required for provider=twilio and used for TwiML and webhook callback URLs. Must be the public HTTPS ngrok/tunnel URL, not localhost.

safety: Real calls remain disabled unless approved true, VOICE_PROVIDER=twilio, VOICE_CALLS_ENABLED=true, and phoneNumber is allowlisted.
Provider credentials are not returned, logged, or stored in call records.
Twilio REST API is called only after local record creation and all gates pass.
Supplier batch calls are not implemented; one phoneNumber is accepted per request.
approved must be true, language must be lt-LT, and phoneNumber must be E.164.
limitations: Lithuanian Twilio Say may still sound accented.
Recording capture works, but transcription is not implemented yet.
voice.getCallResult may show recording metadata with transcriptionPending true.
Supplier batch calls remain intentionally disconnected.
